title: Bound trailing bytes on an unmodified EUR text path
changes: Establish a conditional zero-terminator barrier between localized initial field contents and callback output, without assuming values of trailing copied bytes.
validation: Wine e158-byte00-field-zero-barrier-wine-m0m6rtgn checks all five authenticated expansions for aligned zero positions and 80 xx prefixes.
The source argument uses original windows e158-byte00-ram-forward-dis-wine-ds4kthpq and e158-byte00-field-copy-dis-wine-wvq_b39w; this does not execute the path.
limitations: Only the exact initialized, unmodified field through 0812e464 and callback 08019eb8 is bounded; intervening modifications, aliases, other producers and callbacks, execution order and ordinary byte00 use remain unproved. Linux, USA and native Windows pending. No performance measurement.
